show_subtitle: Amy & Sam take apart how human civilization actually got built—one survival puzzle at a time.

tts.note: Primary GA model (gemini-3.8-flash-tts) via Gemini Interactions API; supports 30 prebuilt voices, 2,000+ Extended Library voices, Voice Design, and pipe backchannels (|mhm|, |wait|). Also supports gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts (cheaper bulk) or legacy gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview.

music.source: J. S. Bach — Suite in E Major, BWV 1006a: Gavotte en Rondeau (solo classical guitar by Emilio Antonucci, Jamendo #108621)

audition_voice_pairs.label: Pair A — Warm & Quick (Recommended)
audition_voice_pairs.notes: Aoede (Breezy, warm female) + Puck (Upbeat, youthful male). Crisp contrast and sharp dry-humor timing.

audition_voice_pairs.label: Pair B — Ultra-Chill Hangout
audition_voice_pairs.notes: Callirrhoe (Easy-going female) + Umbriel (Easy-going male). Calm, laid-back Sunday-afternoon curiosity.

audition_voice_pairs.label: Pair C — Warm Guide + Deadpan Skeptic
audition_voice_pairs.notes: Sulafat (Warm, friendly female) + Zubenelgenubi (Casual, unbothered male). Steady narrative + deadpan engineering pushback.

audition_voice_pairs.label: Pair D — Crisp Deadpan Contrast
audition_voice_pairs.notes: Kore (Firm, crisp female) + Puck (Upbeat, youthful male). Classic straight-man contrast that lets dry humor pop.

audition_music_themes.label: Theme 1 — Warm Acoustic Pluck & Marimba
audition_music_themes.prompt: A warm, curious, chill 30-second instrumental podcast theme song. Gentle plucked acoustic guitar, soft wooden marimba melody, subtle brushed snare groove, understated warm bass. Curious documentary vibe like a smart science and history podcast. Medium-relaxed tempo around 96 BPM. Strictly instrumental, no vocals, no lyrics, clean warm ending.

audition_music_themes.label: Theme 2 — Chill Lo-Fi Rhodes & Soft Percussion
audition_music_themes.prompt: A relaxed, smart, cozy 30-second instrumental podcast theme song. Warm electric Rhodes piano chords, gentle muted kalimba motif, soft warm upright bass, light shaker groove. Thoughtful, inviting, unhurried vibe for a curiosity podcast. Tempo around 90 BPM. Strictly instrumental, no vocals, no lyrics, clean warm fade.

audition_music_themes.label: Theme 3 — Subtle Ancient Pluck Meets Modern Indie
audition_music_themes.prompt: A refined, chill 30-second instrumental podcast intro theme blending gentle modern indie acoustic fingerpicking with a subtle hint of warm oud and soft hand percussion, plus a light cello drone. Evokes ancient engineering and timeless curiosity without sounding overly dramatic or cinematic. Tempo around 94 BPM. Strictly instrumental, no vocals, no lyrics.
